settings.title: What Is Long Distance Towing?

settings.editor:
Long distance towing is a professional service for moving cars, SUVs, trucks, vans, motorcycles and other vehicles between cities, regions or provinces. It is used when a vehicle is broken down, damaged after a collision, not drivable, or simply being relocated. Because the vehicle rides on a flatbed, its odometer, tires, transmission and drivetrain are protected during the trip.

Common reasons people book long distance towing:

  • Breakdown far from home (highway, rural road or another city)
  • Accident recovery and transport to a repair shop or insurer's yard
  • Moving a vehicle after buying it (private sale, dealership or online auction)
  • Relocating to or from Alberta
  • Transporting a vehicle to a specialist mechanic or collision centre
  • Moving classic, luxury, low-clearance or AWD vehicles that cannot be driven or towed by wheel-lift

settings.title: Long Distance Towing Across Alberta

settings.editor:
BP Towing provides long distance towing from Calgary to all major Alberta cities and highways, including:

  • Calgary to Red Deer (approx. 150 km)
  • Calgary to Lethbridge (approx. 210 km) via Highway 2 and Highway 3
  • Calgary to Medicine Hat via Highway 1 (Trans-Canada)

  • Calgary to Grande Prairie, Fort McMurray and Lloydminster

Beyond Alberta: We also arrange towing to British Columbia (Kelowna, Vancouver, Kamloops), Saskatchewan (Regina, Saskatoon) and other provinces. Call us for interprovincial rates.

settings.title: How Much Does Long Distance Towing Cost in Calgary?

settings.editor:
Long distance towing cost depends on:

  • Distance: Usually charged per kilometre after a base hook-up fee
  • Vehicle type and weight: A motorcycle costs less to tow than a heavy truck
  • Truck type: Flatbed vs wheel-lift vs heavy-duty
  • Time and urgency: After-hours, holiday and emergency calls may cost more
  • Road and weather conditions: Winter and remote pickups may affect pricing
  • Vehicle condition: Accident-damaged or stuck vehicles may need extra equipment

For an exact figure, call (403) 991-2265 or request a free quote online.

settings.title: Tips Before Booking Long Distance Towing

settings.editor:
• Have your vehicle's make, model, year and condition ready.
  • Confirm exact pickup and drop-off addresses.
  • Remove valuables and personal items from the vehicle.
  • Tell the dispatcher if the vehicle is AWD, lowered, damaged, or won't roll or steer.
  • Ask whether the quote includes tolls, fuel and after-hours fees.
